LanguageData.MRA_SettingsIntro: Read-only check of the loaded save: choose enabled mods and see which of their content is still present. Nothing is changed or saved.
LanguageData.MRA_NeedLoadedGame: Load a save (or start a game) to use the auditor.
LanguageData.MRA_Disclaimer: Read-only audit of the currently loaded save. "No detected instances" only covers the scopes listed under Coverage and is NOT a guarantee that a mod is safe to remove. Back up your save and test-load it after disabling a mod.
LanguageData.MRA_SelectMods: Enabled mods (Core and DLC are not listed)
LanguageData.MRA_NoReportYet: Select one or more mods on the left and press Scan. The game stays paused while this window is open.
LanguageData.MRA_ScanningHint: The scan runs in small steps each frame while the game is paused. Cancelling discards partial results.
LanguageData.MRA_ScanCancelled: Scan cancelled. No result is shown for a cancelled scan; press Scan to run it again.
LanguageData.MRA_ScanFailed: Scan failed and produced no result: {0}
LanguageData.MRA_AbortGameChanged: The loaded game changed during the scan.
LanguageData.MRA_CachedReport: Result of the earlier scan at {0}. The colony may have changed since; press Re-scan for current data.
LanguageData.MRA_Verdict_Detected: Detected: {0} instance(s) found. Investigate before removing this mod.
LanguageData.MRA_Verdict_NoDetectedInstances: No detected instances within the checked scopes (not a guarantee of safe removal).
LanguageData.MRA_Verdict_Incomplete: Incomplete: nothing was found, but some scopes were partial or failed, or content of unknown origin exists.
LanguageData.MRA_VerdictTip_Detected: At least one thing, material or terrain from this mod is still present in a scanned scope.
LanguageData.MRA_VerdictTip_NoDetectedInstances: Every attempted scope finished and nothing from this mod was found. Data outside the listed scopes (pawn data, quests, research, mod-specific saved data…) was not inspected.
LanguageData.MRA_VerdictTip_Incomplete: Absence of findings cannot be relied on: see the Coverage section and the unknown-origin note.
LanguageData.MRA_NoteUnscannedDefs: Also defines {0} def(s) of types this version does not scan: {1}
LanguageData.MRA_NoteAssemblies: Loads its own C# assemblies; custom data it saves is not inspected.
LanguageData.MRA_Unattributed: {0} instance(s) of {1} def(s) have no recorded source mod and may belong to any mod, including a selected one. Hover for details.
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_maps: All loaded maps: spawned things and nested contents
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_world: World objects: caravans, settlement stock, transport pods, gravships
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_terrain: Terrain on all loaded maps (all layers)
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_pawndata: Pawn data (hediffs, genes, traits, abilities, xenotypes)
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_records: Bills, research, quests, factions, ideoligions, tales and art
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_customdata: Mod-specific saved data and runtime-generated content
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_gravshipterrain: Terrain carried by a gravship in flight
LanguageData.MRA_Scope_unloaded: Maps and saves that are not currently loaded
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_provenance: Which mod declares each thing and terrain def, built from the loaded mods' def lists.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_maps: Every loaded map, including maps you are not viewing and pocket maps: items, buildings, plants, pawns, blueprints/frames, and everything inside containers, inventories, apparel, equipment and corpses.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_world: Caravans and their cargo, settlement trade stock, travelling transport pods, sites and gravships in flight.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_worldpawns: Pawns stored by the world (faction leaders, quest pawns, former colonists, dead pawns kept for relations) with their inventory, apparel and equipment.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_terrain: Top, under, foundation and temporary terrain layers of every loaded map, counted per cell.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_pawndata: Not inspected in this version. Planned for a later version.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_records: Not inspected in this version. Planned for a later version.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_customdata: Mods can save arbitrary data of their own; it cannot be inspected generically.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_gravshipterrain: Things and pawns aboard a gravship in flight are scanned, its stored floor tiles are not.
LanguageData.MRA_ScopeTip_unloaded: Only the save that is currently loaded is inspected.
LanguageData.MRA_Warn_HoldersFailed: {0} container(s) could not be read ({1}); see the log.
LanguageData.MRA_Warn_MapsRemoved: {0} map(s) were removed during the scan and skipped.
LanguageData.MRA_FindingsTruncated: Very many distinct locations: further locations were merged into "other locations" rows. Counts are complete.
LanguageData.MRA_NoFindings: No content from the selected mods was found in the checked scopes.
LanguageData.MRA_Reason_Declared: Declared by this mod and by no other loaded mod.
LanguageData.MRA_Reason_Shadowed: Another loaded mod declares a def with the same name; removing one of them may leave the other's version in place.
LanguageData.MRA_Reason_NotInOwnerDefs: The def names this mod as its source but is not in the mod's own def list (probably created by code at runtime).
LanguageData.MRA_Reason_NoOwner: The def has no recorded source mod.
LanguageData.MRA_TipHandlesTruncated: Jump cycles through the first {0} instances only.
LanguageData.MRA_Loc_MapUnspawned: Held by {0} (not placed on a cell)
LanguageData.MRA_Loc_WorldPawnDead: Dead world pawn: {0} (not on any map)
LanguageData.MRA_JumpTip: Closes this window and shows the location. Reopen the window to see this result again. {0} instance location(s) recorded.
LanguageData.MRA_Jump_Gone: It no longer exists. Re-scan for current data.
LanguageData.MRA_Jump_Changed: The terrain there has changed. Re-scan for current data.
LanguageData.MRA_Jump_OffMap: Not on a loaded map or world object (for example a world pawn); see the holder text.
